requirement: Every plan unit must own executable acceptance; gate units must cover positive, negative and recovery behaviour.
hypothesis: Five gate units (BQ-003, BQ-004, QA-002, QA-003, REL-002) list zero acceptance identities in plan/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.json and own none in verification/EFFECTIVE_TEST_CONTRACTS_REV118.json, so they could be declared complete with no oracle. The package verifiers (verify_review_contracts.py 79/79, verify_whole_product.py 26/26, run 2026-10-21 at package tree ac0226a2) pass with this omission present.
before_architecture: BQ-003/BQ-004 exit contracts require verified outcomes, fault-injection receipts and exact identity across their domains; QA-002/QA-003 require signed-app real-provider and cross-domain adversarial evidence; REL-002 requires owner-approved retirement after parity. None binds an acceptance identity.
after_architecture: Additive patch: BQ-003 co-lists 18 existing identities (INT+REC of BE-014..019,021; NEWS/CHART scenario POS/NEG) plus 3 new HEADLESS identities; BQ-004 co-lists 20 (INT+REC of BE-023..029; six domain POS) plus 3 new; QA-002 and QA-003 get 3 new each (no existing identity tests the signed app or cross-domain bypass); REL-002 co-lists T-NX-054 (its own requirement VAN-NX-054 already names REL-002) plus the 'own negative tests' T-NX-054 demands (T-REL-002-NEG/REC).

reuse_determination.BQ-003: PARTIAL: existing -INT (producer-to-consumer against complete services, no stub) and -REC (crash/restart, no duplicate effects) correctly cover per-unit behaviour; no identity asserts the BQ exit's whole-domain headless run, fault-injection receipts and 'no feature partial' rule -> 3 new.
reuse_determination.BQ-004: PARTIAL: same reasoning over BE-023..029 -> 3 new.
reuse_determination.QA-002: NONE: no identity exercises the exact signed APK against the real gateway/providers -> 3 new.
reuse_determination.QA-003: NONE: 36 T-BE-*-SEC identities are backend-level per unit; none tests cross-domain bypass through the app. They are preconditions, not co-listed -> 3 new.
reuse_determination.REL-002: PARTIAL: T-NX-054 covers positive retirement-after-parity; its text requires separate negative tests that do not exist -> 2 new.

acceptance.positive: ap001.py check: patched_findings == [] and patch_problems == [] and preservation_findings == [].
acceptance.negative: ap001.py selftest 13/13: emptied unit, missing NEG, unknown identity, deleted or reordered identity, unrelated gate losing coverage, downstream-owned co-listing, missing owner addition, unspecified observable, result-claiming or colliding identity are each detected.
acceptance.recovery: If admission adds or changes any unit, re-run ap001.py and pre001.py trace check; package verifiers' hard-coded 1,610 counts must be regenerated through compile_rev118.py, not edited by hand.

expected_benefit: Five gate units become falsifiable; no unit can pass with zero oracles.
observed_benefit: Document-level only; no application test exists or ran.
uncertainty: Reviewer may prefer different reuse sets or a single aggregate identity per unit; the optional verification requirement-ownership binding for BQ-003/BQ-004 may be admitted or declined independently.
complexity_ref: No new service, store or process; 14 new contracts and 39 co-listings (18 BQ-003 + 20 BQ-004 + 1 REL-002). An earlier figure of 41 co-listings was a counting error, corrected here.
failure_and_recovery: Rejected or modified admission leaves the package unchanged; the five omissions stay open in TRACE_CHECK and keep PRE-001 OPEN.
rollback: Not applied to the package; nothing to roll back until admitted.
authority_effect: None. Proposal only; admission requires the package's documented owner/independent process (CONSOLIDATION_APPLY_PROTOCOL steps 3-5). No financial, provider or live authority.

Update count assertions through regeneration, rerun all ten package verifiers plus ap001.py and pre001.py, repackage with manifest and receipt
Invalidate any dependent receipts; record the amendment in the authority selector
